name: spoton-tests
description: SpotOn privacy/security test harnesses. Not deployed; run by a Claude session with a shell. See README.md in this folder.

scripts.test:emulator: node -e "const f=require('fs');f.mkdirSync('.rules-copy',{recursive:true});for(const r of ['firestore.rules','storage.rules'])f.copyFileSync('../'+r,'.rules-copy/'+r)" && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage,auth --project demo-spoton "node --import ./register.mjs rules-test.mjs && node --import ./register.mjs purge-retention-test.mjs && python3 auth-cleanup-test.py"
scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:emulator
